interpretation: Components are measured within individual concurrent processes; their sum is job-seconds, not campaign elapsed time. Graph construction is counted once per execution process, including checkpoint continuations. Sample-call time includes warmup, retained draws and internal setup, including deferred JIT; chain phase sums are breakdowns, not additional costs. Preflight repeat medians are descriptive and not added to totals. Python/import startup, post-admission forecast/recovery and outer coordinator overhead were not timed. Four chains were sequential; no four-process startup benchmark is implied. These are synthetic costs, not a production rolling-refit budget.
